<a name="module_app/config/rate-limit-store..createRateLimitStoreManager"></a>

### app/config/rate-limit-store~createRateLimitStoreManager([options]) ⇒ <code>Promise.&lt;RateLimitStoreManager&gt;</code>
Create and connect the store manager used by every application limiter.

Memory mode delegates to express-rate-limit's local default. Redis mode
opens one connection and creates a distinct RedisStore per limiter because
each store owns limiter-specific window configuration.

**Kind**: inner method of [<code>app/config/rate-limit-store</code>](#module_app/config/rate-limit-store)
**Returns**: <code>Promise.&lt;RateLimitStoreManager&gt;</code> - Connected store manager.

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [options] | <code>Object</code> |  | Store manager configuration. |
| [options.createRedisClient] | <code>function</code> |  | Redis client factory override. |
| [options.mode] | <code>&quot;memory&quot;</code> \| <code>&quot;redis&quot;</code> |  | Backing store selection. |
| [options.prefix] | <code>string</code> |  | Application and environment key prefix. |
| [options.redisUrl] | <code>string</code> |  | Redis or TLS-enabled Redis connection URL. |
| [options.connectTimeoutMs] | <code>number</code> | <code>5000</code> | Connection attempt budget in milliseconds. |
| [options.commandTimeoutMs] | <code>number</code> | <code>2000</code> | Per-command budget in milliseconds. |
